trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including Parodia arnostiana (confirms it produces yellow flowers) and Thalictrum (confirms it is a flowering plant genus). Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents with additional Thalictrum species, all confirming flowering characteristics. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including the genus Parodia article and a list of largest genera of flowering plants.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved key documents that directly refuted the claim by showing both Parodia arnostiana and Thalictrum are flowering plants. The summarizer correctly identified this refutation in both summary steps. The query generator produced queries that, while verbose and containing multiple questions, successfully retrieved additional corroborating evidence in hops 2 and 3. All three retrievals completed and returned relevant documents. The final output contains 24 documents as specified by the concatenation of all three hops. No structural failures occurred; the pipeline behaved exactly as specified.
